audit.whatIsWrong: Every spike and cooldown line referenced Bear Trap and Chaaaaaaaarge!!! without a single number.
audit.why: Bear Trap on a Rope is 11/10/9/8/7s and Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is 140/125/110s. A 140s ultimate against your 11s grenade is the whole reason 'hold E for his engage' is correct advice rather than a preference — and an 11s hook is the exact gap in which you step up.
audit.corrected: 11s and 140s written into breakdown.cooldowns, mid, spikes[2], dosFull[0].d and report[5].

audit.whatIsWrong: Chaaaaaaaarge!!! was described only as a dash past the turret line. Its shield was never mentioned in any of the three fields that describe the engage.
audit.why: Riot's text: Kled and Skaarl charge, leaving a speed trail 'and gaining a shield'. He arrives with burst absorption already active, so a grenade-plus-beams answer thrown at the moment of arrival is eaten. The correct sequencing is to spend the stun on the charge and the damage after the shield expires.
audit.corrected: Shield written into spikes[2], wants.foe[1] and mid with the sequencing spelled out.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization and the late-game block both told the reader to rush anti-heal because 'his healing fights your pattern'.
audit.why: Kled has no healing in his kit. The passive restores SKAARL's health by earning courage through fighting — Grievous Wounds is not the lever. Rylai's, already in the build, is: the slow stops a dismounted Kled from closing to earn the remount.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal line replaced with the Rylai's-denies-remount reason in report[8] and breakdown.late.

audit.why: The brief's autoreset-burst-tell entry for Violent Tendencies is a flag misfire — Riot's text is 'massive attack speed for four attacks', with no attack reset. The existing page already handles this correctly by describing it as attack-speed shred, so nothing was changed and no reset was asserted.

edits.after: One turret and no grenade stun against a mounted Kled: his 11s Bear Trap yanks him onto you and Skaarl shreds. Concede.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Kled carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items in and his percent-HP grab plus earned remounts out-stat the buildings. Carry threat 7/10 — group, don't duel.

edits.before: - Kled Bear Trap on a Rope: matchup-defining — His engage hook. E-stun/dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.

edits.before: This is your stretch. With three turret charges and the CH-3X Lightning Grenade you own the zone — if he dismounts and steps in to trade with Skaarl gone, land the center-stun, fan Hextech Micro-Rockets, and let the electron beams shred him while he's locked and unable to earn his remount. Bait the dismount: on foot he has no Skaarl to bail him out, so punish him the instant he commits a grab and whiffs. Save your grenade for his all-in rather than poking with it, because once he hits 6 his Chaaaaaaaarge!!! can leap onto you past the turret line.
edits.after: This is your stretch. With three turret charges and the CH-3X Lightning Grenade you own the zone — if he dismounts and steps in to trade with Skaarl gone, land the center-stun, fan Hextech Micro-Rockets, and let the electron beams shred him while he's locked and unable to earn his remount. Bait the dismount: on foot he has no Skaarl to bail him out, so punish him the instant he commits a grab and whiffs. Save your grenade for his all-in, not poking: at 6 Chaaaaaaaarge!!! arrives past the turret line on 140s with a shield already eating your burst, so spend the stun on the charge itself.

notes: Two chart rows disagreed with the paragraphs directly beneath them (level 1 and 2+ items), both fixed as matched full+content pairs and both now agree with packet.levelChart. Kled has NO healing — the itemization block prescribed anti-heal 'because his healing fights your pattern'; his passive restores Skaarl by earning courage, so that was replaced with the Rylai's-denies-remount reason. Chaaaaaaaarge!!! grants a shield on arrival, which none of the three fields describing his engage mentioned; that is the reason the grenade must go on the charge and the damage after.
